title: 470,000 FCFA in scholarships awarded to Class 6 pupils
excerpt: On 26 August 2022, 470,000 FCFA was distributed in scholarships to Class 6 pupils of P.S. Mbengwi Annex Guneku for their performance in the 2022 Common Entrance and First School Leaving Certificate examinations.
body:
On the afternoon of Friday, 26 August 2022, the sum of 470,000 FCFA was distributed as scholarships to Class 6 pupils of P.S. Mbengwi Annex Guneku.

The awards recognised outstanding performance in the 2022 Common Entrance and First School Leaving Certificate examinations.

This distribution is a dated record from the village archive. It is recorded separately from the annual Afor Foundation award of 1,000,000 FCFA, with which it should not be confused.
